name: Sweetly Sweetened Sweets
source:
Who doesn't want friends?

At least, Aq wants that, and more.

As a slightly less edgy cat girl at 17, you hang out with your friends and crush on a rabbit.

[From [url=https://mintglow.itch.io/sweetly-sweetened-sweets]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
誰不想擁有朋友呢？

至少，Aq想要，而且想要的不止這些。

你是一位17歲、叛逆勁兒稍稍收斂了些的貓娘，與朋友們一起玩耍，還暗戀著一隻兔子。

[摘自[url=https://mintglow.itch.io/sweetly-sweetened-sweets]Itch.io[/url]]
